chapters.title: What is your favorite kind of weather?

tracks.title: What is your favorite kind of weather?

metadata.author: Dora
metadata.description: Dora speaks both English and Spanish, and now you can too! Follow along with your bilingual amiga and her best buddy Boots as they teach you some of their favorite words and phrases en Español! ¡Vámonos! Let’s go!
